title: Ex-vivo characterization of Drosophila heart functional parameters
protocol: Anesthetize the insects with FlyNap® according to the provider's instructions.
Coat a petri dish with a thin layer of petroleum jelly.
Paste flies dorsal side down on the coated petri dish with wings outstretched.
Place scissors behind the third pair of legs at a 45º angle and cut to remove the head, legs, and part of the thorax.
Add oxygenated artificial hemolymph and cut the genial portion to create an opening.
Introduce scissors through the previous opening and cut through the whole abdomen to the thorax.
Use forceps to remove the intestine, reproductive organs, and fat from the abdomen.
Remove any extra fat or non-cardiac tissue remnants near the heart using a suction pump and patch pipet without touching the organ.
Replace the hemolymph with new artificial hemolymph.
Take extra care removing fat surrounding the heart during dissection.
Record 20 s videos of each beating heart under bright field microscopy using a high-speed camera at least at 160 frames/s.

Process videos using the software program described in Ocorr et al. 2014 to generate cardiac parameters such as heart period, heart rate, arrhythmia index, systolic interval, diastolic interval, percentage of fractional shortening, end systolic diameter, and end diastolic diameter.
Ensure a minimum of 20 fly hearts per experimental condition or genotype are recorded for proper statistical power.
Transfer the dissected flies dorsal side down in a 96-well plate.
Fix the flies with 4% PFA for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Wash the samples three times for 10 minutes each with 1X PBS.
Wash the samples with ice-cold 70% ethanol.
Replace the ethanol with washing solution for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Add hybridization solution without the probe to prehybridize the samples for at least one hour in darkness.
Denature the probe at 80°C for five minutes. Add it to the hybridization solution at a 1:100 dilution and replace the prehybridization solution with the diluted probe.
Hybridize the samples overnight in darkness at 37°C.
Wash the samples with washing solution for 30 minutes at the hybridization temperature.
Transfer the samples to slides and cover with mounting medium including DAPI.
Place a coverslip on top of the mounted samples.
Transfer the dissected flies dorsal side down to a 96-well plate.
Fix the flies with 4% PFA for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Wash the samples three times for 10 minutes each with PBT.
Block the samples with blocking solution for 30 min at room temperature.
Incubate overnight with primary antibody (1:200) at 4°C.
Wash the samples with PBT, 3 times for 10 min each.
Add 200 µl of biotinylated anti-sheep secondary antibody (1:200) and incubate it for 30 min at room temperature.
Wash the samples with PBT, 3 times for 10 min each.
Add ABC mixture, following the manufacturer’s instructions, to amplify the signal and incubate it for 30 min.
Wash the samples with PBT, 2 times for 15 min each.
Incubate the samples with streptavidin-FITC (1:1000) solution for 1 h at room temperature.
Wash the samples with 1X PBS 3 times for 10 min each.
Mount the samples with mounting medium containing DAPI.
Collect 18-20 fly hearts with only the cuticle attached.
Transfer dissected hearts to 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tubes.
Add 200 μl of Qiazol solution to each tube and homogenize samples with a pestle.
Add 500 μl of Qiazol to each tube and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Add 200 μl chloroform to each tube, shake vigorously for 15 s.
Incubate the tubes at room temperature for 3 min.
Centrifuge the samples at 4°C for 15 min at 12000 g.
Transfer the upper phase to new 1.5 ml tubes.
Add 1 ml of absolute alcohol and mix gently.
Load 700 μl of the mixture onto the kit column and centrifuge for 15 s at 12000 g.
Repeat the previous step with any remaining alcohol mixture.
Add 500 μl of RPE buffer to the columns and centrifuge for 15 s at 12000 g.
Add another 500 μl of RPE buffer, then centrifuge the columns for 1 min at 12000 g.
Transfer the kit column to a new 1.5 ml tube and add 25 μl of RNase-free water.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 12000 g.
Repeat the previous step once more to obtain 50 μl of total eluate.
CallCheck the concentration of the RNA extract.
Use 1 μg of total RNA in a volume of 8 μl.
Add 1 μl of DNase buffer and 1 μl of DNase.
Incubate the samples at 37°C for 30 min.
Stop DNase by heating all the samples at 75°C for 10 min.
Add 1 μl of dNTPs and 1 μl hexamers and incubate all the samples at 65°C for 5 min.
Add 4 μl of 5x buffer, 1 μl of DTT, 1 μl of RNase out and 1 μl of Superscript II to all the samples.
Set the following program in the thermocycler: 25°C for 10 min, 42°C for 50 min, 70°C for 15 min and 4°C.
Save the samples at -20°C for future use.
